title: Watering the workload
scene: An exhausted office worker at a kitchen table waters a towering stack of blank paperwork planted in a flowerpot, while the houseplant beside it wilts.
alt_text: An exhausted office worker at a kitchen table waters a towering stack of blank paperwork planted in a flowerpot, while…
interpretations: responsibility: work receives all the care
growth: the workload keeps expanding
neglect: the real plant is forgotten
review_reason: The competing plants make misplaced care visible.
ambiguity_risk: Paperwork can overpower the quieter neglect reading.

title: Emergency spoon
scene: A sleepy adult lowers a tiny spoon into an enormous cereal bowl using a construction crane. They sit in slippers on a kitchen chair, watching the spoon swing above breakfast with the solemn concentration of someone facing a difficult workday.
alt_text: A sleepy adult lowers a tiny spoon into an enormous cereal bowl using a construction crane.
interpretations: effort: breakfast needs heavy machinery
dependence: the crane performs a basic task
appetite: the bowl dwarfs its owner
review_reason: Small breakfast effort becomes an oversized undertaking.
ambiguity_risk: Crane detail must remain secondary to breakfast.

title: Fridge consultation
scene: A tired person sits on a folding chair facing an open refrigerator as if attending a private appointment. A cucumber rests upright on the opposite shelf, and the person earnestly holds out their empty dinner plate for inspection.
alt_text: A tired person sits on a folding chair facing an open refrigerator as if attending a private appointment.
interpretations: advice: the fridge seems to counsel its owner
hunger: the plate awaits a meal
loneliness: an appliance becomes company
review_reason: The empty plate makes the consultation readable without words.
ambiguity_risk: The cucumber could appear merely stored unless clearly upright.

title: Laundry nest
scene: An adult curls into a neat circular nest made from unfolded clean clothes on a sofa. Beside them, a perfectly empty laundry basket holds a single decorative cushion, while a small reading lamp lights this carefully arranged surrender.
alt_text: An adult curls into a neat circular nest made from unfolded clean clothes on a sofa.
interpretations: comfort: chores become bedding
avoidance: folding is postponed
resourcefulness: the laundry gains another purpose
review_reason: The swapped cushion makes deliberate surrender legible.
ambiguity_risk: Avoid making the person look trapped or distressed.

title: Rent-sized room
scene: A tenant proudly unlocks a shoebox-sized apartment door in the middle of a full-sized wall. Their packed suitcase towers over the doorway, and they hold a housewarming plant that is already too large to fit through it.
alt_text: A tenant proudly unlocks a shoebox-sized apartment door in the middle of a full-sized wall.
interpretations: ambition: the plant assumes room to grow
restriction: the entrance is impossibly small
arrival: the luggage signals a fresh start
review_reason: The plant adds optimism beyond the tiny-home gag.
ambiguity_risk: Do not add price signs that force one reading.

title: Meal preparation museum
scene: An exhausted cook stands behind velvet ropes admiring a single neatly packed lunch container on a pedestal. The kitchen behind them is buried in ordinary bowls and vegetable peelings, while a spotlight gives the modest lunch an extravagant glow.
alt_text: An exhausted cook stands behind velvet ropes admiring a single neatly packed lunch container on a pedestal.
interpretations: achievement: lunch receives an exhibition
waste: preparation dwarfs the result
pride: the cook celebrates a small success
review_reason: The kitchen aftermath supplies the cost of the achievement.
ambiguity_risk: Museum props must not hide the edible lunch.

title: Sofa checkpoint
scene: A person carrying groceries has stopped halfway across their living room to rest at a miniature campsite. Their sofa is only a few steps away, but a pitched tent, folded map and tiny cooking pot frame the remaining journey.
alt_text: A person carrying groceries has stopped halfway across their living room to rest at a miniature campsite.
interpretations: rest: a short task needs a break
journey: crossing home becomes travel
burden: the groceries make progress difficult
review_reason: The visibly nearby sofa sets the comic distance.
ambiguity_risk: Keep the campsite safe and without a live flame.

title: Mug lifeboat
scene: A desk worker in a dressing gown sits inside an oversized coffee mug floating on a shallow sea of blank envelopes. A teaspoon serves as their oar, and a dry office chair waits tantalizingly beyond the rippling paper surface.
alt_text: A desk worker in a dressing gown sits inside an oversized coffee mug floating on a shallow sea of blank envelopes.
interpretations: escape: the mug carries someone away
routine: coffee becomes essential transport
overload: envelopes cover the room
review_reason: An active paddler gives the paper sea a defensible purpose.
ambiguity_risk: Avoid disaster imagery or distressed background people.

title: Vacuum treaty
scene: A person lies peacefully on a rug while their robot vacuum carefully cleans around a little fence built from slippers. Outside the fence the room is spotless; inside it crumbs remain beside the sleeper's relaxed hand and unfinished snack.
alt_text: A person lies peacefully on a rug while their robot vacuum carefully cleans around a little fence built from slippers.
interpretations: boundaries: slippers protect a private zone
compromise: only part of the room gets cleaned
rest: the person keeps their nap
review_reason: The clean boundary makes the compromise visible.
ambiguity_risk: Robot vacuum may need recognizable wheels and a round body.

title: Pillow promotion
scene: An adult in office clothes presents a plush pillow with a small blank gold medal. Their own desk chair is empty behind them, while the pillow sits upright at the desk facing an untouched keyboard under an attentive lamp.
alt_text: An adult in office clothes presents a plush pillow with a small blank gold medal.
interpretations: reward: rest earns recognition
replacement: the pillow takes the worker's seat
loyalty: a comforting object receives gratitude
review_reason: The empty chair ties the absurd ceremony to ordinary fatigue.
ambiguity_risk: The medal must have no lettering or official insignia.

title: Last clean fork
scene: A diner protects one clean fork inside a glass display case on their kitchen counter. Behind them, a mountain of dirty dishes crowds the sink, while a steaming plate waits at the table with a conspicuously empty place beside it.
alt_text: A diner protects one clean fork inside a glass display case on their kitchen counter.
interpretations: value: a common fork becomes precious
delay: dinner waits for access
consequence: dirty dishes create the shortage
review_reason: The ready meal creates a concrete cost for overprotection.
ambiguity_risk: Glass glare must not obscure the fork.

title: Curtain sunrise
scene: A person in pajamas pulls open heavy curtains to reveal another pair of heavy curtains immediately behind them. They hold a cheerful watering can and stand beside a hopeful houseplant, with their morning enthusiasm visibly beginning to fade.
alt_text: A person in pajamas pulls open heavy curtains to reveal another pair of heavy curtains immediately behind them.
interpretations: delay: the day has another barrier
hope: plant care was planned
privacy: too many curtains block the world
review_reason: The plant supplies a second stake beyond opening curtains.
ambiguity_risk: Only two curtain layers are needed for visual clarity.

title: Tiny victory podium
scene: A weary adult stands on a low winners' podium holding one fitted bedsheet folded into an imperfect square. The rest of the bedroom remains messy, and two abandoned sheet bundles occupy the lower steps as if they were defeated rivals.
alt_text: A weary adult stands on a low winners' podium holding one fitted bedsheet folded into an imperfect square.
interpretations: success: folding earns a podium
perfection: an imperfect square still counts
persistence: earlier attempts surround the winner
review_reason: The imperfect result keeps the celebration human.
ambiguity_risk: Podium must use unnumbered steps rather than text.

title: Pantry archaeology
scene: A home cook gently brushes dust from a forgotten potato using an archaeologist's soft brush. The potato lies on a kitchen shelf among ordinary jars, while the cook wears a headlamp and holds a tiny protective cushion beneath the discovery.
alt_text: A home cook gently brushes dust from a forgotten potato using an archaeologist's soft brush.
interpretations: discovery: old groceries become an artifact
delay: food waited long enough for excavation
care: a humble object receives attention
review_reason: The kitchen shelf anchors the excavation in daily neglect.
ambiguity_risk: Show an intact potato rather than spoilage or mold.

title: Dishwasher puzzle
scene: An adult studies a dishwasher whose racks form a complicated wooden maze. They hold one plate at the entrance with a puzzled but determined expression, while several clean plates stand safely beside them like spectators awaiting the next attempt.
alt_text: An adult studies a dishwasher whose racks form a complicated wooden maze.
interpretations: strategy: loading becomes route planning
obstruction: racks prevent a simple action
patience: the person still tries carefully
review_reason: The single waiting plate makes the maze's purpose clear.
ambiguity_risk: Keep the plate large enough to remain the focal object.

title: Charging the blanket
scene: A tired person plugs a completely ordinary blanket into an oversized wall socket and waits under it on the sofa. A small bedside lamp glows beside them, while their shoes remain on as though recovery must happen between errands.
alt_text: A tired person plugs a completely ordinary blanket into an oversized wall socket and waits under it on the sofa.
interpretations: energy: comfort becomes recharging
impatience: shoes suggest unfinished errands
security: the blanket offers refuge
review_reason: The shoes add everyday urgency to the charging metaphor.
ambiguity_risk: Render a fanciful soft connector, without unsafe exposed wiring.

title: Umbrella indoors
scene: An apartment resident calmly opens an umbrella beneath a ceiling fan that showers loose socks around the room. A laundry basket sits directly below the fan, and the resident continues holding their tea as though this weather is routine.
alt_text: An apartment resident calmly opens an umbrella beneath a ceiling fan that showers loose socks around the room.
interpretations: protection: an umbrella handles a home problem
routine: tea continues through chaos
circulation: socks travel instead of getting folded
review_reason: Tea and the laundry basket explain calm adaptation.
ambiguity_risk: Flying socks should read as fabric rather than debris.

title: Reversible dinner
scene: A person carefully turns a takeaway box inside out on a dining table dressed for an elegant meal. The food stays in one small pile, while polished cutlery and a single flower show considerable effort invested in pretending dinner was planned.
alt_text: A person carefully turns a takeaway box inside out on a dining table dressed for an elegant meal.
interpretations: presentation: packaging becomes tableware
improvisation: a late meal gains ceremony
effort: decoration compensates for simple food
review_reason: The unchanged food gives the pretence a visual anchor.
ambiguity_risk: Avoid recognizable restaurant packaging or printed branding.

title: Plant delegation
scene: A busy adult hands a tiny watering can to a sturdy houseplant, whose broad leaf bends toward a smaller pot. The adult is already pulling on a coat, while the two plants occupy the only tidy corner of a rushed hallway.
alt_text: A busy adult hands a tiny watering can to a sturdy houseplant, whose broad leaf bends toward a smaller pot.
interpretations: trust: the larger plant is given a task
growth: one plant supports another
escape: the adult leaves a responsibility behind
review_reason: The departing coat makes the delegation an everyday shortcut.
ambiguity_risk: Leaf position must suggest action without adding a mascot face.

title: Room under construction
scene: A person rests on a fully made bed surrounded by waist-high toy construction barriers. Beside the bed, a single unfolded shirt lies on the floor as the only unfinished work, and the sleeper wears a satisfied expression beneath their eye mask.
alt_text: A person rests on a fully made bed surrounded by waist-high toy construction barriers.
interpretations: permission: barriers justify a rest
delay: one shirt keeps the project open
comfort: the bed is already usable
review_reason: One trivial unfinished object exposes the disproportionate response.
ambiguity_risk: Keep barriers visibly miniature and nonofficial.

title: Snail-paced kettle
scene: A person waits patiently beside a kettle balanced on the back of a large gentle snail. The snail inches toward an empty mug across the kitchen counter, while the person has settled into a portable chair with a blanket over their knees.
alt_text: A person waits patiently beside a kettle balanced on the back of a large gentle snail.
interpretations: patience: tea moves slowly
adaptation: waiting becomes a campsite
anticipation: the empty mug marks the goal
review_reason: The mug establishes a destination without written explanation.
ambiguity_risk: The snail should carry a cold closed kettle without steam.

title: Cushion avalanche
scene: An adult tries to sit on a small sofa completely occupied by carefully arranged decorative cushions. One foot remains on the floor as they balance on the only tiny gap, while an empty armchair holds their practical everyday bag.
alt_text: An adult tries to sit on a small sofa completely occupied by carefully arranged decorative cushions.
interpretations: excess: decoration consumes useful space
balance: sitting becomes a physical challenge
appearance: the sofa looks prepared but unusable
review_reason: The practical bag getting a whole chair sharpens the misplaced priority.
ambiguity_risk: Keep the pose steady rather than depicting a painful fall.

title: Freezer time capsule
scene: A person in a kitchen opens a freezer drawer and discovers their own miniature living room preserved in ice. A tiny sofa contains a frozen remote control, while the full-sized person holds an empty ice tray with affectionate resignation.
alt_text: A person in a kitchen opens a freezer drawer and discovers their own miniature living room preserved in ice.
interpretations: memory: a familiar room is preserved
waiting: relaxation has been frozen
control: the remote cannot be reached
review_reason: The remote makes postponed leisure tangible.
ambiguity_risk: Scale must clearly separate the miniature room from real surroundings.

title: Shopping-list sail
scene: An adult sits in a shopping cart fitted with a sail made from a blank sheet of paper. A gentle breeze carries the cart past untouched groceries in a quiet aisle, while its passenger calmly steers with a leek like a tiller.
alt_text: An adult sits in a shopping cart fitted with a sail made from a blank sheet of paper.
interpretations: direction: the cart needs steering
avoidance: shopping turns into sailing
freedom: an aisle becomes open water
review_reason: Groceries and steering support several readings of the detour.
ambiguity_risk: Keep the aisle empty of bystanders and the cart slow.

title: Sock reunion desk
scene: An adult operates a miniature lost-property counter from their laundry basket, presenting two obviously mismatched socks to each other. Several other single socks wait neatly in a row, while a desk lamp gives the tiny encounter the gravity of official business.
alt_text: An adult operates a miniature lost-property counter from their laundry basket, presenting two obviously mismatched socks…
interpretations: belonging: single socks seek partners
compromise: an imperfect match may suffice
order: laundry becomes administration
review_reason: Visible mismatch prevents the scene becoming a simple reunion.
ambiguity_risk: Socks need distinct shapes as well as colors.
